title: Spicy Cacio e Pepe Pasta
description: A spicy twist on the classic Italian pasta dish. This recipe combines the creaminess of cacio e pepe with the heat of yellow peppers.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add diced yellow peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in cacio e pepe and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Drain cooked spaghetti and add to the skillet. Toss with cacio e pepe mixture until well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, topped with grated parmesan cheese.
